question: Which of the following annual events is primarily associated with the state of Odisha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bali Yatra**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Bali Yatra** is the annual event associated with the state of** Odisha**.
 
• Bali Yatra is a festival that commemorates the **rich maritime history of Odisha**.
